question: Take the interaction partners of TP53 in the Human Protein Atlas. How many are there? Give the distribution of their main subcellular location as a bar chart and the fraction whose main location includes the nucleus. Which of the partners have a validated prognostic association (favourable or unfavourable) in any TCGA cancer cohort? Provide the table.

turns.text: I'll start by exploring the available tables.
The schema is large. Let me focus on the interaction table and find TP53's partners.

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query": "SELECT Gene, Ensembl, Gene synonym FROM proteinatlas WHERE Gene='TP53'"}

tool_uses.name: sql

turns.text: 123 partners. Now let me get their main subcellular locations.

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input:
{"query": "WITH partners AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ensembl_gene_id_2 AS p FROM interaction_consensus WHERE ensembl_gene_id_1='ENSG00000141510'
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT ensembl_gene_id_1 AS p FROM interaction_consensus WHERE ensembl_gene_id_2='ENSG00000141510'
)
SELECT pa."Subcellular main location" AS loc, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM partners p
LEFT JOIN proteinatlas pa ON pa.Ensembl = p.p
GROUP BY loc
ORDER BY n DESC"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input:
{"query": "WITH partners AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ensembl_gene_id_2 AS p FROM interaction_consensus WHERE ensembl_gene_id_1='ENSG00000141510'
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT ensembl_gene_id_1 AS p FROM interaction_consensus WHERE ensembl_gene_id_2='ENSG00000141510'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_partners,
  COUNT(pa.Ensembl) AS in_proteinatlas,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pa."Subcellular main location" LIKE '%Nucle%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS including_nucleus
FROM partners p
LEFT JOIN proteinatlas pa ON pa.Ensembl = p.p"}

turns.text: All 123 partners are in proteinatlas (9 have an empty main location). Now let me get the validated prognostic associations.

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query": "SELECT DISTINCT \"validated prognostic - favorable\", \"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" FROM cancer_prognostic_data LIMIT 20"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input:
{"query": "WITH partners AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ensembl_gene_id_2 AS p FROM interaction_consensus WHERE ensembl_gene_id_1='ENSG00000141510'
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT ensembl_gene_id_1 AS p FROM interaction_consensus WHERE ensembl_gene_id_2='ENSG00000141510'
)
SELECT cpd."Gene name", pa.Gene, cpd.Cancer,
  cpd."validated prognostic - favorable" AS fav,
  cpd."validated prognostic - unfavorable" AS unfav
FROM partners p
JOIN cancer_prognostic_data cpd ON cpd.Gene = p.p
JOIN proteinatlas pa ON pa.Ensembl = cpd.Gene
WHERE cpd.Cancer LIKE '%(TCGA)%'
  AND (COALESCE(cpd."validated prognostic - favorable",'')<>'' OR COALESCE(cpd."validated prognostic - unfavorable",'')<>'')
ORDER BY pa.Gene, cpd.Cancer"}
